messages:
elaine: alert from restore-orchestrator: multiple restores erroring with 'missing envelope metadata' when trying to decrypt s3 snapshots.
ben: can you paste the exact log?
elaine: ```
2026-05-12T09:10:01Z ERROR restore: decrypt failed for s3://backups-prod/snapshots/2026-05-11/tenant-61.snap - missing user metadata x-rw-envelope-id
```
omar: that header is how we map to the envelope key in our key registry. which process touched these objects recently?
kyla: storage team pushed a lifecycle-copy job last week to migrate older snapshots to Glacier-IA with a copy routine. the migration wrapper used a generic copy utility that sets metadataDirective=REPLACE.
ben: ugh. REPLACE without reattaching our rw metadata will strip envelope ids. do we have any manifests for those prefixes? sometimes the index contains the envelope mapping.
elaine: quick scan: 9 objects affected, 6 of them have companion .meta files with envelope ids, 3 do not.
ops_bot: migration job logs -> https://internal.logs/redwood/job/4678 show CopyObject calls with metadataDirective=REPLACE between 2912320000-2912340000.
omar: immediate mitigation: stop the lifecycle-copy job and switch it to metadataDirective=COPY when copying snapshots, or explicitly rewrite userMetadata to include x-rw-* headers. kyla, can you pause it?
kyla: pausing now. will flip to COPY for snapshots and redeploy in 8m.
ben: remediation approach: for objects with .meta files we can batch run s3.copy_object with metadataDirective=REPLACE and set userMetadata from the .meta -> then trigger decrypt. for the 3 without meta, we should not guess envelope ids. escalate to security/legal before any re-encrypt or manipulation.
omar: agree. also add a pre-deploy test that runs a small copy and validates userMetadata preserved.
elaine: support: two customers filed restore failures. I'm drafting a customer-safe notification saying we're investigating and have paused migration.
kyla: patch ready, rolling out now. tests show new copies preserve x-rw-* headers.
ops_bot: scan complete: 9 affected objects in backups-prod/snapshots/2026-05-11; 6 with .meta present. Report: https://internal.tasks/scan/6231
ben: plan: restore metadata for 6 via copy_object -> run restores; for 3 escalate. owners: kyla (migration fix), omar (remediation script + KMS checks), elaine (customer comms + triage).
omar: I'll prepare a small replay tool to reattach metadata from manifests and document steps in the runbook. We'll also add immutable audit headers to detect future stripping.
elaine: incident P2 for now; no plaintext exposure found. regroup in 30m for updates. :thumbsup:
